summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MedConnect Medicine Information & Pharmacy Marketplace platform. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% pass rate), but critical frontend-backend authentication integration issue discovered blocking user workflows.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend auth forms fail with 401 Unauthorized errors when submitting to backend APIs
integration_issues.impact: Users cannot login or register, blocking all authenticated features
integration_issues.console_error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401

passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with hero section, features, and how-it-works
Language toggle (EN/HI) switches text content successfully
Auth page loads with Sign In/Sign Up tabs that switch correctly
Sign Up form displays properly with Full Name, Email, Password, Role selection
Sign In form displays properly with Email and Password fields
All backend APIs working: auth, medicines, pharmacies, price comparison, AI info
Backend user registration and login APIs respond correctly
Medicine search, categories, and detail APIs functional
AI medicine information with GPT-5.2 integration working
Pharmacy and inventory management APIs functional

success_percentage.frontend_ui: 90% - UI loads and displays correctly, forms render properly
success_percentage.frontend_integration: 0% - Critical auth integration failure blocking all workflows

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix frontend-backend authentication integration. The frontend auth forms (login/register) are receiving 401 Unauthorized responses from backend APIs, preventing users from signing in or registering. Backend APIs work correctly when tested directly, but frontend cannot successfully authenticate users. Investigate CORS configuration, JWT token handling, API request headers, or cookie/session management between frontend and backend.
